desc_en: A fluid silhouette that redefines evening elegance. This floor-length design features a sleeveless cut and a draped fall that subtly follows every movement. The back details bring a distinctive character to the piece. Crafted on demand to ensure exclusivity. Available with worldwide shipping.

Los detalles posteriores aportan un carácter distintivo a la pieza. Confeccionada bajo demanda para garantizar exclusividad. Disponible con envíos a todo el mundo.
